title: "Father's Shadow"
next_chapter_hook: Just as the Demonic Path leader's words left his mouth, the Tianji Record Fragment at Chen Ji's brow center suddenly emitted blinding golden light, an overwhelming pressure beyond human will descending from the Nine Heavens—Heaven's Eye opened its pupil once more.

text.content: The Demonic Path leader's words were like a soft blade poisoned and tempered, lightly slicing open the scar in Chen Ji's heart that he thought had long healed. The air around seemed to freeze into millennium-old cold ice, only the words 'the debt your father owed back then' echoing repeatedly in his ears. Chen Ji lowered his eyes, slender eyelashes casting faint shadows on his pale face, yet the corner of his lips curved into a smile even harder to look at than crying.

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan's son? Heh..." The Demonic Path leader stepped forward slowly, his玄black robe shimmering with an eerie glow under the blood-colored moonlight. "Your father was equally overestimating himself back then, standing on the side of the so-called righteous path while doing the dirtiest of deeds. Unfortunately, he thought he could hide it from everyone, not knowing from the very beginning, he was the brightest discarded piece on our chessboard.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his eyes that had always been as still as dead water now churning with terrifying waves. He stared at the Demonic Path leader, his voice ice-cold: "My father's death was not unrelated to the Five Elders. This, I know better than anyone." He paused, his voice slightly trembling. "Since you bring it up today, surely you mean to tell me—what hidden truths here am I unaware of?"

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path leader suddenly threw his head back in wild laughter, the sound mournful as a night owl's cry: "The Five Elders? Those fools are merely scapegoats!" He abruptly pressed closer to Chen Ji, lowering his voice, word by word. "Do you know—your father Chen Xuan—he was the true guardian of the Tianji Record?"

text.content: These words exploded like a thunderclap in Chen Ji's mind. His entire body stiffened, his fingertips trembling involuntarily. Guardian of the Tianji Record... that meant his father wasn't a traitor at all, but like Mo Xiansheng, had been secretly guarding this enormous secret all along? Chen Ji下意识地 pressed his right hand against his chest, where the Tianji Record Fragment was emanating a faint warmth.

dialogue.content: Back then, Heaven's mandate descended—wanting the Tianji Record destroyed—because this extraordinary book was too逆天了, even Heaven could not fully control its power." A complex light flickered in the Demonic Path leader's eyes. "Your father, to preserve the Tianji Record, didn't hesitate to soil his own reputation, betray the righteous path, and throw himself into our Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, becoming the 'traitor' in our eyes. He used his life's performance to deceive everyone.

choice.prompt: Facing the shocking truth revealed by the Demonic Path leader, Chen Ji needed to make a choice—

choices.text: "Inquire about the cause of father's death"
choices.description: "Since my father was the guardian, then how did he die? Why did the Five Elders have to take the blame for this?"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain the complete truth about father's death"
choices.risk_hint: "The truth may be more cruel than imagined"

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. His voice was hoarse yet carried undeniable firmness: "Since my father was the guardian, then he... how did he die?" Those words seemed squeezed from between his teeth. "The Five Elders were merely scapegoats? What does that mean?"

choices.description: "How much truth can a Demonic Path person speak? This could all be a scheme of sowing discord!"
choices.risk_hint: "If the truth is real, may forever miss the chance to understand father"

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold laugh, that smile hiding blades: "The Demonic Path people's skill at reversing black and white, Chen has witnessed today." His gaze blazed as he stared directly at the Demonic Path leader. "Why should I believe what you say is true? Perhaps this is merely your scheme to sow discord between me and the Tianqing Sect!"

dialogue.content: "Whether you believe it or not depends on yourself." The Demonic Path leader嗤笑一声. "But there is one thing you must know—your father did not die at the hands of the Five Elders, but was personally erased by Heaven's Eye. When he was about to pass down the Tianji Record to you, Heaven sensed his intention and descended divine punishment, crushing both his soul and flesh simultaneously."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his heart being grasped by an invisible hand, almost unable to breathe. Fifteen years ago on that rainy night, he had hidden in the corner of the woodshed, watching his father being carried home covered in blood, thinking he had just suffered fatal injuries after a conflict with the Five Elders. Now he learned that the torrential blood rain was actually Heaven's punishment.

dialogue.content: Those five fools thought they had killed Chen Xuan, gloating about it for so many years." The Demonic Path leader's tone carried thick mockery. "They didn't know, the true executor was Heaven itself. The Five Elders were merely chess pieces Heaven used to cover up the truth, and your father became the sacrifice in this millennium-old deception."

text.content: Chen Ji's nails dug deep into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers, yet he was oblivious. The grief and rage churning in his chest almost burst through the dam of reason, but in the next instant was replaced by an even more bone-deep chill—turns out from the very beginning, he had been living within Heaven's chess game. Father was a piece, and so was he.

dialogue.content: What, can't accept it?" The Demonic Path leader pressed step by step. "You think that by carefully hiding your strength and playing the fool all these years, you can escape Heaven's eyes? Naive! From the moment you activated the Tianji Record, you were destined to be erased by Heaven—your father's precedent isn't obvious enough?"

choices.description: "The Demonic Path leader knows this much, clearly with ulterior motives. First stabilize him, figure out his cards."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain intelligence from within the Demonic Path"

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, a bitter smile appearing on his face. He stepped back half a pace, putting on a defeated appearance, his voice slightly trembling: "Since the Esteemed One knows so much, surely you also understand... I am merely a poor wretch being pushed along by fate." He raised his eyes, his gaze carrying just the right amount of confusion and fear. "What do you truly want from me today?"

choices.description: "Father sacrificed his life to guard the Tianji Record, he absolutely will not let father's sacrifice be in vain!"
choices.risk_hint: "May anger the other party, inviting death"

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, the grief in his eyes transforming into iron-like will in that moment. He said word by word: "My father died guarding the Tianji Record. If I too die by Heaven's hand, that is our fate." His voice wasn't loud, yet it exploded like thunder. "But as long as I have one breath left, I will never kneel and wait for death!"

dialogue.content: "Good! Good, never kneel and wait for death!" The Demonic Path leader clapped and laughed loudly, yet the laughter carried a thread of admiration. "Indeed Chen Xuan's son, this unyielding spirit, exactly like your father." He收起笑容, his gaze deep and幽深. "But do you think, with your current strength, you can resist Heaven?"

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer, merely quietly staring at the Demonic Path leader. Under the moonlight, his figure was thin yet upright, like a green pine stubbornly growing in the storm. In his mind, father's vague dying words suddenly became clear—"Ji'er... live on... for father... see what this Heaven... truly is..."

At this moment, the Fragment at Chen Ji's chest suddenly burned intensely. An unprecedented sense of crisis rushed in from all directions, as if some invisible eyes were piercing through the Void, staring at him fixedly. That feeling he would never forget—fifteen years ago on that rainy night, when father died, he was being watched by the same gaze.

Heaven's Eye..." Chen Ji murmured, his voice carrying a thread of自嘲. "I haven't even had time to shed tears for my father, and you are already迫不及待要 make your move?" He raised his head, staring directly at the void, as if confronting an invisible enemy. "Fine, very good. Today Chen Ji will wait right here—let's see if this so-called Heaven can truly kill someone who has already died once!"

choices.text: "Activate Tianji Record to resist with all strength"
choices.description: "Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate, forcibly activate the Tianji Record's foresight ability, trying to find a thread of survival"

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly pressed his right hand against the Fragment at his chest, the Tianji Record's power surging forth like a breached dam. His eyes transformed in an instant into two small golden suns, pupils reflecting countless fragments of the future. Golden light confronted the giant eye in the sky, erupting in earth-shaking thunder. "Who do you think you are?" Chen Ji嘶吼. "Just a幕后黑手 manipulating everyone's fate!"

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly turned his head, his gaze like lightning shooting toward the Demonic Path leader: "You tell me all this today, surely not just to watch me make a fool of myself!" His voice was ice-cold and resolute. "Speak, what do you want me to do?" A gleam of admiration flashed in the Demonic Path leader's eyes. He waved his sleeve, and a玄black light curtain enveloped Chen Ji, temporarily cutting off Heaven's Eye's gaze. "Smart one." He whispered. "The seal beneath the Tianqing Sect... you need to go there yourself."

Just as the two forces held each other in stalemate, the giant eye in the sky suddenly contracted, and a紫金色 lightning bolt shot out, heading straight for Chen Ji's brow center. The speed was too fast, faster than light could chase. Chen Ji only had time to see that destructive light infinitely enlarge before his eyes, yet a familiar voice rang in his ears—father's final words before death, gentle as a dream: "Ji'er, don't be afraid... father has always been watching over you..."

The紫金色 lightning pierced through the玄black light curtain, yet mysteriously stopped in mid-air. A broken Turtle Shell emerged from Chen Ji's chest, an heirloom he had carried since childhood—his father's only memento. The densely packed runes on the Turtle Shell were flashing frantically, as if conducting some ancient ritual. Chen Ji widened his eyes, finally understanding why father left this seemingly useless Turtle Shell—therein was sealed father's final wisp of residual soul!

Chen Ji knelt on both knees, hands cradling that Turtle Shell, entire body trembling. Tears slid down silently, moistening his chest. Fifteen years, he thought he had long forgotten how to cry; fifteen years, he thought he had buried all sorrow in the deepest recesses of his heart. But now, when father's voice rang out again, all pretense collapsed in an instant. He opened his mouth, wanting to say something, yet discovered his throat was blocked by something, not a single word able to escape.
